newsitem.title: RUSSIA: DMG plans expansion of Moscow trading.
newsitem.headline: DMG plans expansion of Moscow trading.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking division of Germany's Deutsche Bank AG, plans a major increase in its Moscow trading operations, the head of DMG's Moscow unit said on Thursday.

Nick Jordan, Managing Director of DMG Moscow, told Reuters the bank had hired Vladimir Merson, formerly head of local currency dealing at CS First Boston in Moscow, to head the bank's trading operations in currency and fixed income.

It is already not unusual for foreign banks in Moscow to hire staff from each other, but this latest high-level move is a further sign that Western banks are taking Russian markets, already driven by foreign investment, increasingly seriously.

Merson, who starts at DMG on July 1 and reports to DMG's London-based head of central and East European local currency trading, Stephen Cain, will build up DMG's local currency dealing team to five from two at present, Jordan said.
DMG will also become a primary dealer in government securities. At present it is a dealer.
